title: fix: the packet check reads the Active Plan and every file named
headline: The resume packet check now always names the Active Plan and every file the Resume Point names for a read, so a new session can no longer miss what waits on the owner or the real plan.
alignment: v1.30.1 fixes the two gaps the 1.30.0 workbench verify found in the packet check, at their root, and the same kind of gap in the tracking check.

items.text: The check always names the Active Plan for a read. A pending list written on its label line, after a blank line or as numbered items came out empty, and the check then skipped the file.
items.where: What a new session sees waiting on the owner
items.before: Nothing, on several common ways of writing the list
items.after: The Active Plan, read fresh every time

items.text: Every file the Resume Point names, up to three, is hashed and read; a file name the check cannot read means the full reading. It used to pick one link as the plan, and some wordings picked the wrong one.
Write names any label or file name a check could not read, and the closeout fixes it before the next session. A label not found names its file for a read instead of the full reading.
A huge tracking file can no longer stall the check: a Resume Point over 4,000 characters is the full reading, and each preview stops at 40 lines.
The tracking check finds a Progress or Parking Lot heading with a suffix or at level three, any list marker, and a Parking Lot label; other shapes passed as empty.

verification: The new packet test fails on the 1.30.0 code and on the first fix the sweep read; the tracking check test fails on 1.30.0.
A copy of the workbench's own tracking files, checked with the fixed script, names the Active Plan and both files its Resume Point names, and shows the whole pending list.

decisions.decision: Fixed now as 1.30.1, not in build 5
decisions.why: The gap is high: a session never saw what waits on the owner. A high never carries; the owner picked the fix now by pop-up.

decisions.decision: The check always reads the Active Plan and every named file
decisions.why: The sweep found a dozen wordings the section and plan guessing misread. The owner ruled by pop-up to stop guessing, for about 400 more tokens a session.

dimensions.name: Code security
dimensions.result: Three highs and six mediums in the section and plan reading, all fixed

dimensions.name: Gaps, scaling, test value
dimensions.result: Two slowdowns, three tracking check shapes and five test gaps, all fixed

dimensions.name: Alignment
dimensions.result: YES; the fix widened to the root on the owner's ruling

fixed: Sections misread on common wordings hid the Active Plan. Fixed in d3d749e.
An unreadable plan link left another file as the plan. Fixed in d3d749e.
An old or later plan link was picked over the real one. Fixed in d3d749e.
A blank line or a numbered item emptied the pending list. Fixed in d3d749e.
accepted: Rule 11 still names the Resume Point's file and the changed files; the verdict also names the Active Plan.
